explanation.title: task
explanation.text: Create the file path for /bonjour. Change only the folder name.

explanation.title: hint
explanation.text: Keep app/ at the start and /page.tsx at the end.

explanation.title: explanation
explanation.text: In App Router, the folder chooses the address. page.tsx provides the content. This simulator shows the address; it does not create a file.

explanation.title: task
explanation.text: Make the card display “Mon premier site”. Change the quoted text.

explanation.title: hint
explanation.text: Keep name and the quotes. The card reads product.name.

explanation.title: explanation
explanation.text: const names an object. name is one property of that object. {product.name} in JSX displays its value. Editing the data changes the text without rewriting the card.

explanation.title: task
explanation.text: Double the card’s inside spacing: replace p-4 with p-8.

explanation.title: hint
explanation.text: p means padding: the distance between the border and the content.

explanation.title: explanation
explanation.text: On Tailwind’s default scale, p-4 is 1 rem and p-8 is 2 rem. You change space around the text, not its content or the product data.

explanation.text: Display a quantity of 3. Pass 3 to setQuantity.

explanation.title: hint
explanation.text: The number in parentheses is the new value you request.

explanation.title: explanation
explanation.text: Like setItems in your cart, an update function asks React to render a new value. Here quantity is demo data, separate from your actual cart.
